relationships.subject: spinal dynorphin-lineage neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Cluster Inhib2 was most highly enriched for Nos1 (Log2FC +1.26), encoding neuronal nitric oxide synthase (nNOS)

key_findings: Single-nucleus RNAseq identified 11 clusters of adult mouse spinal dynorphin-lineage cells, including 7 inhibitory, 2 excitatory, a CSF-contacting cluster and a glial cluster.

Neonatal hindpaw incision persistently altered 15 genes in adult pDyn neurons, with pan-neuronal upregulation of Gm26848 and downregulation of Fth1, Pcsk1n and Ubb, and excitatory-specific upregulation of Oxr1.
